one_liner: CivicState turns civic concerns into cited official letters, but demand and deliverability remain unproven.
directive: Use BUSINESS.md as the seed plan; operator merge and POM soul-review are required before authority upgrades.

authority.adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: brief]; see the PR's POM record

sources: registry dispatch notes supplied by runner

planningMethod: Bottom-up validation plan: paid campaigns x blended order value, with all external market claims marked as assumptions.

customer.definition: US residents with concrete civic concerns who want help researching, drafting, routing, and delivering constituent letters.
customer.primaryICP: Mobile-first individual residents with local, state, or federal civic issues.

market.tam: $225,000,000 [assumption: 15,000,000 civically active digital users x $15 blended order value]
market.sam: $45,000,000 [assumption: 20% of TAM reachable under email-only, US-only constraints]
market.som: $900,000 [assumption: 2% of SAM captured over modeled horizon]
market.method: Bottom-up paid-campaign model, not top-down civic-tech spend.
market.freshness: As of 2026-06-19 [evidence: runner current_date]; external market data not fetched.

revenueStreams: Future higher-touch review [assumption: deferred revenue stream]
Future organization/API access [assumption: deferred revenue stream]

revenueAssumptions: Blended AOV is $15 [assumption: tier mix around middle package].
Paid campaigns reach 300 by 2026-12-31 [assumption: beta trajectory].
Paid campaigns reach 12,000 in the final modeled period [assumption: GTM success].
costAssumptions: Direct AI and delivery cost is $0.80 per campaign [assumption: buffer above repo placeholder].
DigitalOcean base cost is $96 per month [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
Operator/compliance support reaches $72,000 in the final modeled period [assumption: staffing need].
sensitivityTests: AOV at $10 reduces final-period revenue to $120,000 [assumption: 12,000 campaigns x $10].
Only 250 paid campaigns per month reduces annual revenue to $45,000 [assumption: 3,000 campaigns x $15].
Direct cost at $2.50 per campaign raises final-period direct cost to $30,000 [assumption: 12,000 campaigns x $2.50].
financialModel.reconciliation: Revenue lines reconcile as paid campaigns multiplied by $15 blended AOV in BUSINESS.md.

alternatives: Manual official lookup and letter writing

holes: Users may not pay for letters even if they like the concept.
Government inboxes may classify AI-assisted mail as spam.
Citation and jurisdiction coverage may fail for local issues.
The product may create legal, defamation, harassment, or lobbying-adjacent risk.
Registry identity mismatch may mean this repo is not the intended project.
mitigations: Domain warming, bounce thresholds, and complaint suppression.
Citation verification and all-fail human review.
Admin review queue and audit logs.
Operator ruling before investment posture changes.
residualRisks: No verified public official deliverability evidence yet.
No legal review included in this workspace-only upgrade.

strategy.posture: Watchlist; validate before investible BOS posture.
strategy.platformPosture: WrkPlug client assumption, not signed; current repo has bespoke auth, billing, queue, database, and delivery rails.

firstChannels: Direct beta users from local civic groups [assumption]
Organic search once public campaign pages exist [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md; implementation not fully verified]
goToMarket.firstHundredCustomers: Recruit manually and log paid/non-paid reasons before paid acquisition.

operatorWorkflow.routine: Exception-based review of flagged submissions, deliverability failures, treasury discrepancies, and official opt-outs.
constraints: Flagged queue escalation above 10 items or oldest item over 24 hours [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md]
Manual approval/reject/edit flow exists in admin routes [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts]
Operator must resolve brooks-history vs CivicState mismatch [evidence: dispatch and repo files]
metrics: Bounce rate by official email domain

rules: Researcher may only cite provided search results [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts].
All-fail citation jobs are flagged for human review [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts].
Letters include AI disclosure and not-legal-advice disclaimer [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/drafter.ts].

unknowns: Whether this repo should be registry project brooks-history.
Whether the operator wants this to pitch as a business.
